name: criminal-procedure
description: Finnish criminal procedure for professionals: pre-trial investigation and coercive measures (805/2011 and 806/2011), the charge and the defence (ROL 689/1997), and the position of the injured party and their civil claims. On the terms of the presumption of innocence and the use of counsel.

interface.longDescription: Finnish criminal procedure for the work of counsel: pre-trial investigation and coercive measures (805/2011 and 806/2011) with preparation for questioning and the closing statement, the charge and the response with the judgment-proposal procedure (ROL 689/1997), and the injured party’s claims and criminal-injuries compensation. On the terms of the presumption of innocence and the use of counsel.
